title.zh: Solana sets Oct. 21 for Alpenglow upgrade targeting 150-millisecond finality
title.en: Solana sets Oct. 21 for Alpenglow upgrade targeting 150-millisecond finality

current_state.zh: Solana has scheduled its Alpenglow consensus upgrade for Oct. 21, targeting roughly 150-millisecond transaction finality by replacing TowerBFT and moving validator votes off-chain, while requiring validators to migrate to Agave 4.3.0.
current_state.en: Solana has scheduled its Alpenglow consensus upgrade for Oct. 21, targeting roughly 150-millisecond transaction finality by replacing TowerBFT and moving validator votes off-chain, while requiring validators to migrate to Agave 4.3.0.
